Recorded claim:
Commands already has broad system access through its Node backend; Electron chiefly adds persistent app/window ownership, native lifecycle, menus/notifications, and controlled embedded pages. Prefer `WebContentsView` over a new `<webview>` design; persistent sessions use `session.fromPartition("persist:name")` and single-instance behavior uses `app.requestSingleInstanceLock()`. [Task 1]
